newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Consortium regrets CA sold to Bank Austria.
newsitem.headline: Consortium regrets CA sold to Bank Austria.

text.p: An international group headed by insurer EA-Generali, which on Sunday lost out in its bid to buy Austria's flagship bank Creditanstalt, said it regretted the Finance Ministry's decision to sell the bank to Bank Austria.

"We submitted....the most attractive offer for the long-term good of Austria's economy," the consortium's spokesman and EA-Generali chief executive Dietrich Karner said in a brief statement on Sunday.

Finance Minister Viktor Klima sold Creditanstalt to market leader Bank Austria for 17.2 billion schillings, bringing to an end the nearly seven-year battle for control of Austria's second-largest bank.

The consortium groups insurer EA-Generali, savings bank Die Erste, Germany's Commerzbank, Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana and Mediobanca, Belgium's Bacob, and a host of Austrian financial and industrial concerns. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
